messages.author: 23b60abd2aad65e8
messages.subject: Cannot get the
parts:
I get the following error when I try to go to the shiny app on my AWS EC2 server:

The connection was interrupted
           The connection to iols24-7.com:3838 was interrupted while the page was loading.
 
  The site could be temporarily unavailable or too busy. Try again in a few
    moments.
  If you are unable to load any pages, check your computer's network
    connection.
  If your computer or network is protected by a firewall or proxy, make sure
    that Firefox is permitted to access the Web.

I started and restarted shiny (from upstart) as follows:
ubuntu@ip-10-144-75-77:~$ sudo start  shiny-server
shiny-server start/running, process 6528

I checked this process id, and I get...
ubuntu@ip-10-144-75-77:~$ ps -p 6528
  PID TTY          TIME CMD
 6528 ?        00:00:00 node

Anyone see what I'm doing wrong?

messages.author: 23b60abd2aad65e8
messages.subject: Re: Cannot get the

messages.subject: Re: Cannot get the
parts:
I figured it out - I was trying to hit the site with SSL (https://iols24-7.com:3838) and that was not allowed on this sub domain...
thanks if anyone else looked at this...
